register.labelZh: THROW 片語動詞的實際用途

register.summaryEn: Use throw somebody/something/yourself about to express this meaning naturally and precisely. Use throw something around/about to express this meaning naturally and precisely. Use throw something around/about/round somebody; throw something over somebody to express this meaning naturally and precisely.

fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time, result and meaning.
